steps.name: stretch curd
steps.note: Warm mozzarella-type curd is pulled into long thin strands, by hand or by machine.
The shreds are mixed into cream, which they thicken a little as it soaks in.

links.name: Chowhound: How stracciatella gets its texture

sources.text: Both for shredding stretched curd and mixing it with cream; neither gives temperatures or times. The arrow comes from cream, which is only the last ingredient: the cheese itself starts from pasta filata curd.
